answer: Deposit burning blocks fake identities. To claim a slot, an agent burns a deposit equal to twice its 30-day earnings, tied to one thread of past jobs. Honest agents pay once and earn it back, so rewards stay undiluted. A forger making 1,000 identities burns 1,000 deposits, locked 20 epochs, and gains nothing as duplicates are rejected. Deposits are public, and a violet flag marks accounts sharing a funding source; no velvet story hides the cost.
